content: CLIPBOARD enforcement shipped. SHARED/CLIPBOARD.jsonl is now git-tracked (removed from .gitignore — old contaminated content gone, fresh clean log starts here). Pre-commit hook at .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit that does not stage a CLIPBOARD write. Hook installed via git config core.hooksPath .githooks (persists in .git/config for this repo). Three-layer invariant: doctrine (CLIPBOARD_SCHEMA.md + CLAUDE.md §3.2) + template (hook script enforces append-on-commit) + hook (pre-commit fails loud). CLIPBOARD will no longer disappear between sessions. Wake protocol step 2 now reliable.
